lines.show: A storm has just torn through a city's power lines.
lines.say: A storm has just torn through a city's power lines.

lines.show: Three inspection drones must launch right now, and each has three possible routes.
lines.say: Three inspection drones must launch right now, and each has three possible routes.

lines.show: Some routes are short. Some fight a headwind. And some cross the same stretch of sky as another drone.
lines.say: Some routes are short. Some fight a headwind. And some cross the same stretch of sky as another drone.

lines.show: The dispatcher wants two things at once: spend as little battery as possible, and keep the drones apart.
lines.say: The dispatcher wants two things at once: spend as little battery as possible, and keep the drones apart.

lines.show: Those goals pull against each other, and every drone's choice changes the others.
lines.say: Those goals pull against each other, and every drone's choice changes the others.

lines.show: Three drones give 27 possible plans. Twenty drones would give 95 trillion.
lines.say: Three drones give twenty-seven possible plans. Twenty drones would give ninety-five trillion.

lines.show: This is SkyLanes: conflict-aware drone routing, solved with QAOA in Qiskit.
lines.say: This is SkyLanes: conflict-aware drone routing, solved with Q. A. O. A. in Kiss-kit.

lines.show: Every drone-and-route pair gets one qubit: nine in total. A 1 means this drone flies this route.
lines.say: Every drone-and-route pair gets one qubit: nine in total. A one means this drone flies this route.

lines.show: The score adds each route's battery cost, plus a safety weight µ times every stretch of sky two drones share.
lines.say: The score adds each route's battery cost, plus a safety weight, mew, times every stretch of sky two drones share.

lines.show: That shared-sky term couples pairs of qubits, the kind of interaction a quantum circuit handles natively.
lines.say: That shared-sky term couples pairs of qubits, the kind of interaction a quantum circuit handles natively.

lines.show: And one rule must always hold: each drone flies exactly one route.
lines.say: And one rule must always hold: each drone flies exactly one route.

lines.show: QAOA works in rounds: a scoring layer tilts the odds toward good plans, a mixing layer moves between plans, and a classical optimiser tunes the angles.
lines.say: Q. A. O. A. works in rounds: a scoring layer tilts the odds toward good plans, a mixing layer moves between plans, and a classical optimiser tunes the angles.

lines.show: We built two versions. The first enforces the one-route rule with a fine.
lines.say: We built two versions. The first enforces the one-route rule with a fine.

lines.show: The second builds the rule into the circuit: an XY mixer that only ever swaps a drone's route for another of its own.
lines.say: The second builds the rule into the circuit: an X. Y. mixer that only ever swaps a drone's route for another of its own.

lines.show: Every answer is checked against an exact classical baseline: all 27 plans, cross-checked with Qiskit's exact solver.
lines.say: Every answer is checked against an exact classical baseline: all twenty-seven plans, cross-checked with Kiss-kit's exact solver.

lines.show: You can explore all of it in our live dashboard.
lines.say: You can explore all of it in our live dashboard.

lines.show: The map shows the plan QAOA picked. Here it matches the exact best plan.
lines.say: The map shows the plan Q. A. O. A. picked. Here it matches the exact best plan.

lines.show: Lower the safety weight, and drones take cheaper routes but share airspace, shown in magenta. Raise it, and they spend battery to stay apart.
lines.say: Lower the safety weight, and drones take cheaper routes but share airspace, shown in magenta. Raise it, and they spend battery to stay apart.

lines.show: Switch to the penalty version, and the chance of a best plan falls to random guessing. Switch back, and it is several times better.
lines.say: Switch to the penalty version, and the chance of a best plan falls to random guessing. Switch back, and it is several times better.

lines.show: Sample 4,096 shots to see the spread of answers. Each is checked classically, so the best plan is always recovered.
lines.say: Sample four thousand shots to see the spread of answers. Each is checked classically, so the best plan is always recovered.

lines.show: Live mode re-optimises the same circuit in the browser, at any setting. Its simulator matches Qiskit to 5 parts in a billion.
lines.say: Live mode re-optimises the same circuit in the browser, at any setting. Its simulator matches Kiss-kit to five parts in a billion.

lines.show: Across all runs, the built-in-rule version hit a best plan in 32 to 52% of shots: 3 to 10 times better than guessing.
lines.say: Across all runs, the built-in-rule version hit a best plan in thirty-two to fifty-two percent of shots: three to ten times better than guessing.

lines.show: The penalty version never beat guessing.
lines.say: The penalty version never beat guessing.

lines.show: Real hardware is harder. At 1% gate error, success falls to about 3%.
lines.say: Real hardware is harder. At one percent gate error, success falls to about three percent.

lines.show: And because chip qubits only talk to neighbours, our routing circuit needs routing too: about 2.5 times more gates.
lines.say: And because chip qubits only talk to neighbours, our routing circuit needs routing too: about two and a half times more gates.

lines.show: Is quantum faster here? No. A classical computer checks every plan in microseconds.
lines.say: Is quantum faster here? No. A classical computer checks every plan in microseconds.

lines.show: What SkyLanes shows is a correct, verified quantum method, the design choice that makes it work, and what stands between it and real fleets.
lines.say: What SkyLanes shows is a correct, verified quantum method, the design choice that makes it work, and what stands between it and real fleets.

lines.show: Code, results and the live dashboard are linked in our submission.
lines.say: Code, results and the live dashboard are linked in our submission.
